  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nAnalyze room 22 sprites and NPC conversation assignment.\n\nRoom 22 has multiple NPCs (McDowell's diner scene).\nThe game uses sprite index to determine which conversation root.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\nroom = 22\nbase = room * 0x68\n\n# Get room pair 10 (room data with sprites)\npair10_offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, base + 0x50)[0]\npair10_size = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, base + 0x54)[0]\n\n# Get room pair 12 (text)\npair12_offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, base + 0x60)[0]\npair12_size = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, base + 0x64)[0]\n\nroom_data = data[pair10_offset:pair10_offset + pair10_size]\ntext_data = data[pair12_offset:pair12_offset + pair12_size]\n\nprint(f\"=== Room 22 Analysis ===\")\nprint(f\"Pair 10 (room data): offset=0x{pair10_offset:x}, size=0x{pair10_size:x}\")\nprint(f\"Pair 12 (text data): offset=0x{pair12_offset:x}, size=0x{pair12_size:x}\")\nprint()\n\n# Sprite count at offset 0x05\nsprite_count = room_data[0x05]\nprint(f\"Sprite count: {sprite_count}\")\nprint()\n\n# Sprite headers start at 0x06, each is 44 bytes (0x2c)\nprint(\"=== Sprites (44 bytes each starting at 0x06) ===\")\nfor i in range(sprite_count):\n    sprite_offset = 0x06 + i * 0x2c\n    \n    # Key fields from sprite header:\n    # +0x0A: x position (2 bytes)\n    # +0x0C: y position (2 bytes)\n    # +0x0E: width (1 byte)\n    # +0x0F: height (1 byte)\n    # +0x21: talk_npc_index (-1 if not talkable)\n    # +0x2A: action data (2 bytes)\n    # +0x2C: action flags (1 byte)\n    \n    x = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', room_data, sprite_offset + 0x0A)[0]\n    y = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', room_data, sprite_offset + 0x0C)[0]\n    w = room_data[sprite_offset + 0x0E]\n    h = room_data[sprite_offset + 0x0F]\n    talk_idx = room_data[sprite_offset + 0x21]\n    action_data = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', room_data, sprite_offset + 0x2A)[0]\n    action_flags = room_data[sprite_offset + 0x2C] if sprite_offset + 0x2C &lt; len(room_data) else 0\n    \n    # Check if sprite is talkable (0x10 flag in action_flags)\n    is_talkable = (action_flags &amp; 0x10) != 0\n    \n    print(f\"Sprite {i}: pos=({x:3},{y:3}) size={w}x{h} talk_idx={talk_idx:3} flags=0x{action_flags:02x} {'[TALKABLE]' if is_talkable else ''}\")\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=== Conversation Roots in Text Data ===\")\nprint(\"Looking for FE markers (conversation roots)...\")\n\n# Find all FE markers in text data\nroots = []\npos = 0\nwhile pos &lt; len(text_data):\n    if text_data[pos] == 0xFE:\n        root_num = text_data[pos + 1]\n        # Get some context after the root\n        context_end = min(pos + 20, len(text_data))\n        context = text_data[pos:context_end]\n        roots.append((pos, root_num, context))\n    pos += 1\n\nprint(f\"Found {len(roots)} conversation roots:\")\nfor pos, root_num, context in roots:\n    print(f\"  Root #{root_num} at text offset 0x{pos:04x}: {context[:10].hex(' ')}\")\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=== NPC-to-Root Assignment Mechanism ===\")\nprint()\nprint(\"Based on check_sprite_hover_and_trigger_conversation:\")\nprint(\"1. Game iterates through sprites starting at index 2\")\nprint(\"2. For each sprite with 0x10 flag set: sprite_talk_count++\")\nprint(\"3. When player clicks NPC, sprite_talk_count determines which root\")\nprint()\nprint(\"This means: NPC's conversation root = number of talkable sprites\")\nprint(\"that appear BEFORE this NPC in the sprite list.\")\nprint()\n\n# Count talkable sprites and their indices\ntalkable = []\ntalk_count = 0\nfor i in range(2, sprite_count):  # Start at 2 (skip Alfred at 0, 1)\n    sprite_offset = 0x06 + i * 0x2c\n    action_flags = room_data[sprite_offset + 0x2C] if sprite_offset + 0x2C &lt; len(room_data) else 0\n    \n    if (action_flags &amp; 0x10) != 0:\n        talkable.append((i, talk_count))\n        talk_count += 1\n\nprint(\"Talkable sprite mapping:\")\nfor sprite_idx, root_idx in talkable:\n    sprite_offset = 0x06 + sprite_idx * 0x2c\n    talk_npc_idx = room_data[sprite_offset + 0x21]\n    print(f\"  Sprite {sprite_idx} (talk_npc={talk_npc_idx}) -&gt; Root #{root_idx + 1}\")\n",

{

  "isConfirmed": {

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nCorrected analysis of room 22 sprites and NPC conversation assignment.\n\nSprite headers are at offset 0x06 in room data, each 44 bytes (0x2c).\nKey fields:\n  +0x00: x position (2 bytes)\n  +0x02: y position (2 bytes)  \n  +0x04: width (1 byte)\n  +0x05: height (1 byte)\n  +0x21: sprite_type (0xFF = not hotspot eligible)\n  +0x22: action_flags (0x10 = TALK action)\n  +0x26: is_hotspot (0x00 = clickable)\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\nroom = 22\nbase = room * 0x68\n\n# Get room pair 10 (room data with sprites)\npair10_offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, base + 0x50)[0]\npair10_size = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, base + 0x54)[0]\n\n# Get room pair 12 (text)\npair12_offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, base + 0x60)[0]\npair12_size = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, base + 0x64)[0]\n\nroom_data = data[pair10_offset:pair10_offset + pair10_size]\ntext_data = data[pair12_offset:pair12_offset + pair12_size]\n\nprint(f\"=== Room 22 Analysis (CORRECTED) ===\")\nprint(f\"Pair 10 (room data): offset=0x{pair10_offset:x}, size=0x{pair10_size:x}\")\nprint(f\"Pair 12 (text data): offset=0x{pair12_offset:x}, size=0x{pair12_size:x}\")\nprint()\n\n# Sprite count at offset 0x05\nsprite_count = room_data[0x05]\nprint(f\"Sprite count: {sprite_count}\")\nprint()\n\n# Sprite headers start at 0x06, each is 44 bytes (0x2c)\nprint(\"=== Sprites (44 bytes each starting at 0x06) ===\")\nfor i in range(sprite_count):\n    sprite_base = 0x06 + i * 0x2c\n    \n    # Read all key fields\n    x = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', room_data, sprite_base + 0x00)[0]\n    y = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', room_data, sprite_base + 0x02)[0]\n    w = room_data[sprite_base + 0x04]\n    h = room_data[sprite_base + 0x05]\n    sprite_type = room_data[sprite_base + 0x21]\n    action_flags = room_data[sprite_base + 0x22]\n    is_hotspot = room_data[sprite_base + 0x26]\n    \n    # Check if sprite is talkable (0x10 flag in action_flags)\n    is_talkable = (action_flags &amp; 0x10) != 0\n    is_clickable = (sprite_type != 0xFF and is_hotspot == 0x00)\n    \n    status = []\n    if is_talkable:\n        status.append(\"TALK\")\n    if is_clickable:\n        status.append(\"CLICK\")\n    status_str = f\"[{', '.join(status)}]\" if status else \"\"\n    \n    print(f\"Sprite {i}: pos=({x:4},{y:4}) size={w:3}x{h:&lt;3} \"\n          f\"type=0x{sprite_type:02x} flags=0x{action_flags:02x} hotspot={is_hotspot} {status_str}\")\n\nprint()\n\n# Find all FE markers in text data\nprint(\"=== Conversation Roots (FE markers) ===\")\nroots = []\npos = 0\nwhile pos &lt; len(text_data):\n    if text_data[pos] == 0xFE:\n        root_num = text_data[pos + 1]\n        roots.append((pos, root_num))\n    pos += 1\n\nprint(f\"Found {len(roots)} conversation roots:\")\nfor pos, root_num in roots:\n    # Get some text context after the root header\n    # Structure: FE &lt;root#&gt; FC &lt;room#&gt; &lt;speaker&gt; &lt;voice_file_id&gt;\n    context = text_data[pos:min(pos + 30, len(text_data))]\n    # Try to find the start of actual text (after control codes)\n    text_start = pos + 8  # Skip typical header\n    text_preview = \"\"\n    for j in range(text_start, min(text_start + 50, len(text_data))):\n        if text_data[j] &gt;= 0x20 and text_data[j] &lt; 0x80:\n            text_preview += chr(text_data[j])\n        elif text_data[j] == 0xFD:\n            break\n        elif len(text_preview) &gt; 0:\n            break\n    print(f\"  Root #{root_num} at 0x{pos:04x}: {text_preview[:40]}...\")\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=== NPC-to-Root Assignment ===\")\nprint()\nprint(\"From check_sprite_hover_and_trigger_conversation:\")\nprint(\"  - sprite_talk_count starts at 0\")\nprint(\"  - For each sprite from index 2 to sprite_count:\")\nprint(\"    - If (action_flags &amp; 0x10) != 0: sprite_talk_count++\")\nprint(\"  - When NPC is clicked, conversation root = sprite_talk_count\")\nprint()\n\n# Count talkable sprites and map them\ntalkable = []\ntalk_count = 0\nfor i in range(2, sprite_count):  # Start at 2 (sprite 0 and 1 are Alfred)\n    sprite_base = 0x06 + i * 0x2c\n    action_flags = room_data[sprite_base + 0x22]\n    \n    if (action_flags &amp; 0x10) != 0:\n        x = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', room_data, sprite_base + 0x00)[0]\n        y = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', room_data, sprite_base + 0x02)[0]\n        talkable.append((i, talk_count, x, y))\n        talk_count += 1\n\nif talkable:\n    print(\"Talkable sprite -&gt; Root mapping:\")\n    for sprite_idx, root_idx, x, y in talkable:\n        print(f\"  Sprite {sprite_idx} at ({x},{y}) -&gt; uses Root #{root_idx + 1}\")\nelse:\n    print(\"No talkable sprites found in this room (sprites 2+ with 0x10 flag)\")\n    print()\n    print(\"Checking ALL sprites for 0x10 flag:\")\n    for i in range(sprite_count):\n        sprite_base = 0x06 + i * 0x2c\n        action_flags = room_data[sprite_base + 0x22]\n        if action_flags != 0:\n            print(f\"  Sprite {i}: action_flags = 0x{action_flags:02x}\")\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=== Text Pointer Table at 0x3DA ===\")\n# The text pointer table at +0x3DA contains pointers to conversation starts\nptr_table_offset = 0x3DA\n# Count available pointers (4 bytes each)\nsprite_base_count = room_data[0x05] + room_data[0x47A]\nnum_npcs_for_ptrs = room_data[0x05] - 2  # Sprites minus Alfred (slots 0,1)\nprint(f\"Sprite count: {room_data[0x05]}\")\nprint(f\"Static hotspot count (at 0x47A): {room_data[0x47A]}\")\nprint()\nprint(\"First few pointers in text pointer table:\")\nfor i in range(min(10, num_npcs_for_ptrs + 5)):\n    ptr_offset = ptr_table_offset + i * 4\n    if ptr_offset + 4 &lt;= len(room_data):\n        ptr = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', room_data, ptr_offset)[0]\n        print(f\"  Pointer {i}: 0x{ptr:08x}\")\n",

}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nAnalyze room 22 static hotspots and NPC conversation assignment.\n\nStatic hotspots at +0x47C, 9 bytes each:\n  +0x00: x (2 bytes)\n  +0x02: y (2 bytes)\n  +0x04: width (1 byte)\n  +0x05: height (1 byte)\n  +0x06: action_flags (1 byte)\n  +0x07: action_data (2 bytes)\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nwith open('files/ALFRED.1', 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\nroom = 22\nbase = room * 0x68\n\n# Get room pair 10 (room data)\npair10_offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, base + 0x50)[0]\npair10_size = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, base + 0x54)[0]\n\n# Get room pair 12 (text)\npair12_offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', data, base + 0x60)[0]\n\nroom_data = data[pair10_offset:pair10_offset + pair10_size]\ntext_data = data[pair12_offset:pair12_offset + pair12_offset + 0x8100]\n\nprint(f\"=== Room 22 Hotspot Analysis ===\")\nprint()\n\n# Sprite count and hotspot count\nsprite_count = room_data[0x05]\nhotspot_count = room_data[0x47A]\nprint(f\"Sprite count: {sprite_count}\")\nprint(f\"Static hotspot count: {hotspot_count}\")\nprint()\n\n# Static hotspots at +0x47C\nprint(\"=== Static Hotspots (9 bytes each at 0x47C) ===\")\nfor i in range(hotspot_count):\n    hs_base = 0x47C + i * 9\n    x = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', room_data, hs_base + 0)[0]\n    y = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', room_data, hs_base + 2)[0]\n    w = room_data[hs_base + 4]\n    h = room_data[hs_base + 5]\n    flags = room_data[hs_base + 6]\n    action_data = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', room_data, hs_base + 7)[0]\n    \n    actions = []\n    if flags &amp; 0x01: actions.append(\"OPEN\")\n    if flags &amp; 0x02: actions.append(\"CLOSE\")\n    if flags &amp; 0x04: actions.append(\"PUSH\")\n    if flags &amp; 0x08: actions.append(\"PULL\")\n    if flags &amp; 0x10: actions.append(\"TALK\")\n    if flags &amp; 0x20: actions.append(\"0x20\")\n    if flags &amp; 0x40: actions.append(\"0x40\")\n    if flags &amp; 0x80: actions.append(\"0x80\")\n    \n    print(f\"Hotspot {i}: rect=({x},{y},{w},{h}) flags=0x{flags:02x} data={action_data} [{', '.join(actions)}]\")\n\nprint()\n\n# Let me also check if there are more hotspots by looking at raw data\nprint(\"=== Raw hotspot area dump ===\")\nraw = room_data[0x47A:0x47A + 50]\nprint(f\"Bytes at 0x47A: {raw.hex(' ')}\")\n\nprint()\n\n# Check the text pointer table more carefully\nprint(\"=== Text Pointer Table Analysis ===\")\nprint(\"The pointers in 0x3DA table should point to text data for each NPC/hotspot\")\nprint()\n\n# Text pointer table - let me find where valid pointers are\nptr_table_start = 0x3DA\nprint(f\"Looking for non-zero pointers starting at 0x{ptr_table_start:03x}...\")\n\n# The number of pointers depends on sprite_count + hotspot_count - 2\n# (sprites 0,1 are Alfred)\nexpected_ptrs = sprite_count - 2 + hotspot_count\nprint(f\"Expected conversation targets: {sprite_count - 2} NPCs + {hotspot_count} hotspots = {expected_ptrs}\")\n\nfor i in range(20):\n    ptr_offset = ptr_table_start + i * 4\n    if ptr_offset + 4 &lt;= len(room_data):\n        ptr = struct.unpack_from('&lt;I', room_data, ptr_offset)[0]\n        if ptr != 0:\n            print(f\"  Ptr[{i}] at 0x{ptr_offset:03x} = 0x{ptr:08x}\")\n\n# Look for the actual conversation starts in text by searching for FE\nprint()\nprint(\"=== All conversation roots in text ===\")\npos = 0\nroot_count = 0\nwhile pos &lt; len(text_data) - 1:\n    if text_data[pos] == 0xFE:\n        root_num = text_data[pos + 1]\n        root_count += 1\n        # Get some context\n        end = min(pos + 100, len(text_data))\n        # Find first printable text\n        text = \"\"\n        for j in range(pos + 6, end):\n            b = text_data[j]\n            if 0x20 &lt;= b &lt; 0x80:\n                text += chr(b)\n            elif len(text) &gt; 0 and b in (0xFD, 0x00, 0xFC):\n                break\n        print(f\"  Root #{root_num} at offset 0x{pos:04x}: \\\"{text[:50]}\\\"\")\n    pos += 1\nprint(f\"Total roots: {root_count}\")\n\n# The key insight is in handle_conversation_tree - it uses:\n# *(int *)(room_sprite_data_ptr + 0x3da + conversation_target_index * 4)\n# where conversation_target_index = sprite_count + hotspot_index - 2\n\nprint()\nprint(\"=== Understanding NPC -&gt; Root Mapping ===\")\nprint()\nprint(\"From handle_conversation_tree:\")\nprint(\"  conversation_target_index = sprite_count - 2 + hotspot_count + queued_sprite_talk_count\")\nprint(\"  pointer = room_data[0x3DA + conversation_target_index * 4]\")\nprint()\nprint(\"Since there are 2 roots (for 2 NPCs) and the pointer table is at 0x3DA,\")\nprint(\"let me check offsets based on sprite count...\")\n\n# Actually the formula in check_sprite_hover_and_trigger_conversation shows\n# it uses queued_sprite_talk_count which accumulates based on 0x10 flags\n# But since no sprites have 0x10 flag, there must be another mechanism\n\n# Let me look at the actual hotspots in room 22 - maybe they're NPCs\nprint()\nprint(\"=== Re-examining Room 22 Structure ===\")\nprint(\"Looking at ALL data around the hotspot/sprite areas...\")\nprint()\n\n# Dump more structure\nprint(f\"Offset 0x1BE (exit count): {room_data[0x1BE]}\")\nprint(f\"Offset 0x213 (walkbox count): {room_data[0x213]}\")\nprint(f\"Offset 0x47A (hotspot count): {room_data[0x47A]}\")\n\n# Check if hotspot structures have TALK flag\nprint()\nprint(\"Hotspot raw data (should be 9 bytes each):\")\nfor i in range(min(10, hotspot_count + 3)):\n    start = 0x47C + i * 9\n    chunk = room_data[start:start + 9]\n    if len(chunk) &gt;= 9:\n        x = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', chunk, 0)[0]\n        y = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', chunk, 2)[0]\n        w = chunk[4]\n        h = chunk[5]\n        flags = chunk[6]\n        data = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', chunk, 7)[0]\n        print(f\"  [{i}] x={x:4} y={y:4} w={w:3} h={h:3} flags=0x{flags:02x} data=0x{data:04x}\")\n",

A 6-byte journal record is written to the save journal file (file handle 0x0004f914)\n\n### Text Data Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nBefore selection:  FD FB &lt;choice#&gt; 08 0D &lt;voice_id_lo&gt; &lt;voice_id_hi&gt; \"Text...\"\nAfter selection:   FD FA &lt;choice#&gt; 08 0D &lt;voice_id_lo&gt; &lt;voice_id_hi&gt; \"Text...\"\n                      ^^ Changes from FB to FA\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Journal Record Format (6 bytes at 0x0004fb70)\n\n| Offset | Size | Field | Description |\n|--------|------|-------|-------------|\n| +0x00 | 2 | room_number | Current room (little-endian) |\n| +0x02 | 2 | text_offset | Offset within room's text data |\n| +0x04 | 1 | length | Always 1 (single byte) |\n| +0x05 | 1 | value | Always 0xFA (disabled marker) |\n\n### Code Flow\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;c\n// At 0x00018c48 in handle_conversation_tree:\n*current_text_ptr = 0xFA;  // Mark as disabled\noffset = current_text_ptr - room_text_data_ptr;\n\n// Write to ALFRED.1 file\nfile_seek(file_handle_alfred1, room_text_base + offset);\nwrite_data_to_alfred1(current_text_ptr, 1, file_handle_alfred1);\n\n// Write journal record  \n_DAT_0004fb70 = current_room_number;\n_DAT_0004fb72 = offset;\nDAT_0004fb74 = 1;      // length\nDAT_0004fb75 = 0xFA;   // value\nwrite_data_to_alfred1(&amp;DAT_0004fb70, 6, DAT_0004f914);  // journal file\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Effect on Choice Display\n\nWhen parsing choices (around 0x000189a1), if the marker is &#96;0xFA&#96;, the choice is skipped:\n- Choice counter decrements for each &#96;0xFA&#96; encountered\n- If all choices in a branch become &#96;0xFA&#96;, conversation auto-proceeds to response\n\n---\n\n## 2. Root Level Disabling (conversation_branch_state_array)\n\n### Memory Location\n- **Address**: &#96;0x0004fba4&#96;\n- **Size**: 4 bytes per room × 56 rooms = 224 bytes\n- **Access Pattern**: &#96;array[room_number * 4 + slot_index]&#96;\n\n### How It Works\n\n1. Script actions (via F8 control codes) call &#96;update_conversation_state&#96; at **0x0001b666**\n2. The function writes to &#96;conversation_branch_state_array[room * 4 + slot]&#96;\n3. When loading a room, the code checks this array\n4. If &#96;array[room * 4 + slot] != 0&#96;, the entire conversation root is skipped\n\n### Code in update_conversation_state (0x0001b666)\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;c\nvoid update_conversation_state(void) {\n    room = get_current_room_number();\n    // Write state to array\n    conversation_branch_state_array[room * 4 + slot] = value;\n    \n    if (room == current_room_number) {\n        // Update text pointer table to skip past disabled root\n        // Scans for FE markers and F7 branch ends\n        // Updates room_sprite_data_ptr + 0x3DA pointer table\n    }\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Text Structure for Roots\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nFE &lt;root_index&gt; FC &lt;room#&gt; &lt;speaker&gt; &lt;voice_file_id&gt; \"NPC greeting...\"\n   └─ Root marker        └─ Speaker ID (08 = Alfred)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 3. NPC-to-Root Assignment (Multi-NPC Rooms)\n\n### The Problem\nIn rooms with multiple NPCs (like Room 22 - McDowell's Diner), how does the game know which conversation root belongs to which NPC?\n\n### The Mechanism\n\nThe game uses a **position-based** system using &#96;queued_sprite_talk_count&#96;:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;c\n// In handle_conversation_tree (0x00018690):\nconversation_index = sprite_count - 2 + hotspot_count + queued_sprite_talk_count;\ntext_ptr = room_data[0x3DA + conversation_index * 4] + 2;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### How queued_sprite_talk_count Works\n\n1. In &#96;check_sprite_hover_and_trigger_conversation&#96; (0x00018e47):\n   - Game iterates through sprites starting at index 2 (skipping Alfred at 0, 1)\n   - For each sprite with &#96;action_flags &amp; 0x10&#96; (TALK flag): &#96;sprite_talk_count++&#96;\n   - When NPC is clicked, &#96;queued_sprite_talk_count = sprite_talk_count&#96;\n\n2. The clicked NPC's position in the \"talkable sprite\" list determines which root is used\n\n### Example: Room with 3 NPCs\n\n| Sprite Index | Has TALK Flag | sprite_talk_count | Uses Root |\n|--------------|---------------|-------------------|-----------|\n| 2 | Yes | 0 | Root #1 |\n| 3 | No | - | - |\n| 4 | Yes | 1 | Root #2 |\n| 5 | Yes | 2 | Root #3 |\n\n### Text Pointer Table\n\n- Located at &#96;room_data + 0x3DA&#96;\n- Contains 4-byte absolute pointers to conversation start positions\n- Index = &#96;sprite_count - 2 + hotspot_count + talk_index&#96;\n\n---\n\n## 4. State Reset for New Game\n\n### Key Question\nHow does the game restore conversation state when starting a new game?\n\n### Investigation Results\n\n**ALFRED.8** and **ALFRED.B** are loaded at game initialization via &#96;load_alfred8_and_alfred9()&#96; at **0x00014977**.\n\n#### ALFRED.8 Format (Pair 10 - Room Data)\n- Restores sprite positions, object states\n- Does NOT contain FB markers\n- Uses offset 0x50 (Pair 10) in room directory\n\n#### ALFRED.B Format (Pair 12 - Text Data)\n- Contains 1180 entries across 28 rooms\n- Each entry: &#96;[room:2][offset:2][length:1][value:1]&#96;\n- **All entries write 0x08** (speaker ID byte), NOT the FB marker!\n- Uses offset 0x60 (Pair 12) in room directory\n\n### Critical Finding\n\n**ALFRED.B does NOT restore FB markers!**\n\n- Every ALFRED.B entry writes &#96;0x08&#96; to the speaker ID position\n- The FB/FA marker is at &#96;offset - 2&#96; from the speaker ID\n- ALFRED.B restores speaker IDs, not conversation enable/disable state\n\n### Actual New Game Mechanism\n\nThe game most likely uses one of these approaches:\n1. **CD-based reset**: Copies clean ALFRED.1 from CD-ROM\n2. **Backup file**: Uses a backup copy of ALFRED.1\n3. **File verification**: The game has CD authentication checks\n\nThe &#96;verify_cd_authenticity()&#96; call in &#96;game_initialization()&#96; suggests the original CD is required, possibly to restore pristine data files.\n\n---\n\n## 5. Summary Tables\n\n### State Tracking Mechanisms\n\n| Level | Marker | Storage | Persistence |\n|-------|--------|---------|-------------|\n| Choice/Branch | &#96;0xFB&#96; → &#96;0xFA&#96; | Direct in ALFRED.1 text | Written to file |\n| Root | &#96;0xFE&#96; | &#96;conversation_branch_state_array[room*4+slot]&#96; | Save journal |\n\n### Control Code Markers\n\n| Byte | Meaning |\n|------|---------|\n| &#96;0xFE&#96; | Conversation root marker |\n| &#96;0xFB&#96; | Dialog choice (enabled) |\n| &#96;0xFA&#96; | Dialog choice (disabled/used) |\n| &#96;0xF1&#96; | Alternative choice marker |\n| &#96;0xF7&#96; | Branch/root end marker |\n| &#96;0xFD&#96; | Text line terminator |\n| &#96;0xFC&#96; | Speaker/room identifier |\n\n### File Roles\n\n| File | Purpose | State Reset Role |\n|------|---------|------------------|\n| ALFRED.1 | Main game data | Modified at runtime with FA markers |\n| ALFRED.8 | Room defaults | Restores sprite/object state (Pair 10) |\n| ALFRED.B | Conversation defaults | Restores speaker IDs only (Pair 12) |\n\n---\n\n## 6. I've completed a comprehensive analysis of the conversation state tracking system and updated the documentation in `CONVERSATION_STATE_TRACKING.md`.

### Key Findings:

1. **Two Tracking Mechanisms:**

3. **NPC-to-Root Assignment (Multi-NPC Rooms):**
   - Uses position-based system via `queued_sprite_talk_count`
   - Formula: `text_ptr = room_data[0x3DA + (sprite_count - 2 + hotspot_count + talk_index) * 4]`
   - Sprites are iterated from index 2 (skip Alfred); those with `0x10` flag increment talk_count
   - The NPC's position among talkable sprites determines which conversation root it uses

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nAnalyze ALFRED.A - this is where conversation state changes are journaled!\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport struct\n\nalfred_a_path = 'files/ALFRED.A'\n\n# Get file size\nsize = os.path.getsize(alfred_a_path)\nprint(f\"ALFRED.A size: {size} bytes\")\n\nwith open(alfred_a_path, 'rb') as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\nprint(f\"Read {len(data)} bytes\")\nprint()\n\n# Show first 200 bytes as hex\nprint(\"=== First 200 bytes ===\")\nfor i in range(0, min(200, len(data)), 16):\n    hex_part = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in data[i:i+16])\n    ascii_part = ''.join(chr(b) if 32 &lt;= b &lt; 127 else '.' for b in data[i:i+16])\n    print(f'{i:04x}: {hex_part:&lt;48} {ascii_part}')\n\nprint()\n\n# Check if it contains 6-byte journal records like what handle_conversation_tree writes\n# Format: [room:2][offset:2][length:1][value:1]\nprint(\"=== Looking for conversation state records ===\")\nprint(\"Journal record format: [room:2][offset:2][length:1][value:1]\")\nprint()\n\n# Try to parse as 6-byte records\nrecords = []\npos = 0\nwhile pos + 6 &lt;= len(data):\n    room = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', data, pos)[0]\n    offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', data, pos + 2)[0]\n    length = data[pos + 4]\n    value = data[pos + 5]\n    \n    # Check if this looks like a valid record\n    if room &lt; 56 and offset &lt; 0x10000 and length in (1, 4, 6, 9, 14):\n        records.append((room, offset, length, value))\n    pos += 6\n\nprint(f\"Found {len(records)} potential 6-byte records\")\nif records:\n    print(\"First 20:\")\n    for room, offset, length, value in records[:20]:\n        print(f\"  Room {room:2}, offset 0x{offset:04x}, len={length}, value=0x{value:02x}\")\n\n# Also check if file contains terminator patterns\nprint()\nprint(\"=== Checking for structure patterns ===\")\nffff_positions = []\nfor i in range(len(data) - 1):\n    if data[i] == 0xff and data[i+1] == 0xff:\n        ffff_positions.append(i)\n\nprint(f\"Found 0xFFFF at positions: {ffff_positions[:10]}...\")\n\n# Check for ALFRED.8/B style terminators\nc9ca_positions = []\nfor i in range(len(data) - 1):\n    if data[i] == 0xc9 and data[i+1] == 0xca:\n        c9ca_positions.append(i)\n\nprint(f\"Found 0xC9CA at positions: {c9ca_positions[:10]}...\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nCheck the save game files and how conversation state is stored.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport struct\n\n# List save game files\nsave_dir = 'files'\nsaves = [f for f in os.listdir(save_dir) if f.startswith('SALVAJOC')]\nprint(f\"Found {len(saves)} save files: {saves}\")\n\nfor save in saves:\n    path = os.path.join(save_dir, save)\n    size = os.path.getsize(path)\n    print(f\"\\n=== {save} ({size} bytes) ===\")\n    \n    with open(path, 'rb') as f:\n        data = f.read()\n    \n    # Header: \"Tic-Tac-Toe 1995\"\n    header = data[:16]\n    print(f\"Header: {header}\")\n    \n    # Save name\n    save_name = data[0x10:0x26]\n    print(f\"Save name: {save_name}\")\n    \n    # Room number\n    room = data[0x26]\n    print(f\"Room: {room}\")\n    \n    # Player position\n    px = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', data, 0x28)[0]\n    py = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', data, 0x2A)[0]\n    print(f\"Player pos: ({px}, {py})\")\n    \n    # Look for 0xFA markers in the save file (disabled conversation choices)\n    fa_count = data.count(bytes([0xFA]))\n    fb_count = data.count(bytes([0xFB]))\n    print(f\"FA bytes: {fa_count}, FB bytes: {fb_count}\")\n    \n    # Look for 6-byte journal-style records\n    print(\"\\nLooking for journal-style records in save...\")\n    # The pattern would be [room:2][offset:2][1][0xFA]\n    journal_records = []\n    for i in range(len(data) - 5):\n        room_num = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', data, i)[0]\n        offset = struct.unpack_from('&lt;H', data, i + 2)[0]\n        length = data[i + 4]\n        value = data[i + 5]\n        \n        # Check for valid-looking journal record\n        if room_num &lt; 56 and offset &lt; 0x8000 and length == 1 and value == 0xFA:\n            journal_records.append((i, room_num, offset))\n    \n    print(f\"Found {len(journal_records)} potential FA journal records\")\n    if journal_records:\n        for pos, room_num, offset in journal_records[:10]:\n            print(f\"  At 0x{pos:04x}: room={room_num}, offset=0x{offset:04x}\")\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nLook for conversation_branch_state_array (224 bytes) in save files.\nThis array is at 0x0004fba4 and indexed by room*4 + slot.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport os\nimport struct\n\nsave_dir = 'files'\nsaves = [f for f in os.listdir(save_dir) if f.startswith('SALVAJOC')]\n\nfor save in saves:\n    path = os.path.join(save_dir, save)\n    with open(path, 'rb') as f:\n        data = f.read()\n    \n    print(f\"=== {save} ===\")\n    \n    # The conversation_branch_state_array is 56 rooms * 4 bytes = 224 bytes\n    # It tracks which conversation ROOTS are disabled\n    # Look for a 224-byte section that might be this array\n    \n    # Show some key offsets in the save file\n    print(f\"Size: {len(data)} bytes\")\n    \n    # Dump areas that might contain conversation state\n    # Based on save format, state data starts around 0x100\n    print(\"\\nBytes at various offsets:\")\n    for offset in [0x34, 0x100, 0x200, 0x300, 0x400, 0x500]:\n        if offset + 32 &lt;= len(data):\n            chunk = data[offset:offset+32]\n            hex_str = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in chunk)\n            print(f\"  0x{offset:04x}: {hex_str}\")\n    \n    # Look for the conversation state array pattern\n    # It should be mostly zeros with occasional non-zero values\n    print(\"\\nLooking for 224-byte sections that could be conversation_branch_state_array...\")\n    for start in range(0, len(data) - 224):\n        section = data[start:start+224]\n        # Count zeros and non-zeros\n        zeros = section.count(0)\n        non_zeros = 224 - zeros\n        # Array should be mostly zeros with a few non-zero values\n        if zeros &gt;= 200 and non_zeros &gt; 0 and non_zeros &lt; 20:\n            print(f\"  Potential match at 0x{start:04x}: {non_zeros} non-zero bytes\")\n            # Show non-zero positions\n            for i, b in enumerate(section):\n                if b != 0:\n                    room = i // 4\n                    slot = i % 4\n                    print(f\"    offset {i}: room {room}, slot {slot} = 0x{b:02x}\")\n    \n    print()\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nDeep analysis of ALFRED.B - understanding its actual purpose.\nUser clarified: 0x08 is a TEXT COLOR command, not speaker ID.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\ndef main():\n    out = []\n    \n    # Read ALFRED.B\n    with open(\"files/ALFRED.B\", \"rb\") as f:\n        alfb = f.read()\n    \n    # Read ALFRED.1\n    with open(\"files/ALFRED.1\", \"rb\") as f:\n        alf1 = f.read()\n    \n    out.append(f\"ALFRED.B size: {len(alfb)} bytes\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Parse ALFRED.B structure\n    # Header: 2 bytes (expected to be count or marker)\n    header = struct.unpack('&lt;H', alfb[0:2])[0]\n    out.append(f\"ALFRED.B header (first 2 bytes): 0x{header:04x} ({header} decimal)\")\n    \n    # Each record is 6 bytes: 4-byte offset + 2-byte something\n    num_records = (len(alfb) - 2) // 6\n    out.append(f\"Number of 6-byte records after header: {num_records}\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Analyze what the records point to\n    # Let's look at patterns in the 2-byte values\n    two_byte_values = {}\n    for i in range(num_records):\n        base = 2 + i * 6\n        offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alfb[base:base+4])[0]\n        value = struct.unpack('&lt;H', alfb[base+4:base+6])[0]\n        if value not in two_byte_values:\n            two_byte_values[value] = []\n        two_byte_values[value].append((i, offset))\n    \n    out.append(\"Two-byte values (after offset) distribution:\")\n    for val, entries in sorted(two_byte_values.items()):\n        out.append(f\"  0x{val:04x}: {len(entries)} entries\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # What if the 2-byte value is what to WRITE, not what's there?\n    # Let's check if the byte at each offset DIFFERS from the 2-byte value\n    out.append(\"Checking if ALFRED.B stores (offset, value_to_restore)...\")\n    \n    matches = 0\n    mismatches = 0\n    mismatch_examples = []\n    \n    for i in range(min(num_records, 50)):  # Check first 50\n        base = 2 + i * 6\n        offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alfb[base:base+4])[0]\n        stored_value = struct.unpack('&lt;H', alfb[base+4:base+6])[0]\n        \n        if offset &lt; len(alf1):\n            actual_byte = alf1[offset]\n            # Compare low byte of stored_value with actual\n            if actual_byte == (stored_value &amp; 0xFF):\n                matches += 1\n            else:\n                mismatches += 1\n                if len(mismatch_examples) &lt; 10:\n                    mismatch_examples.append((i, offset, stored_value, actual_byte))\n    \n    out.append(f\"  First 50 records: {matches} matches, {mismatches} mismatches\")\n    if mismatch_examples:\n        out.append(\"  Mismatch examples:\")\n        for rec, off, stored, actual in mismatch_examples:\n            out.append(f\"    Record {rec}: offset 0x{off:x}, stored=0x{stored:04x}, actual=0x{actual:02x}\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Let's look at the context around targeted offsets more carefully\n    out.append(\"Context analysis of first 20 targets:\")\n    out.append(\"Looking for patterns - what comes BEFORE and AFTER the target byte\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    for i in range(min(num_records, 20)):\n        base = 2 + i * 6\n        offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alfb[base:base+4])[0]\n        stored_value = struct.unpack('&lt;H', alfb[base+4:base+6])[0]\n        \n        if offset &gt;= 5 and offset + 5 &lt; len(alf1):\n            context_before = alf1[offset-5:offset]\n            target = alf1[offset]\n            context_after = alf1[offset+1:offset+6]\n            \n            ctx_hex = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in context_before)\n            aft_hex = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in context_after)\n            \n            out.append(f\"Record {i}: offset 0x{offset:06x}\")\n            out.append(f\"  Stored value: 0x{stored_value:04x}\")\n            out.append(f\"  Context: [{ctx_hex}] [TARGET:{target:02x}] [{aft_hex}]\")\n            \n            # Check if FB or FA is nearby\n            for j, b in enumerate(context_before):\n                if b in [0xFB, 0xFA]:\n                    out.append(f\"  ** FB/FA marker at offset-{5-j} **\")\n    \n    out.append(\"\")\n    out.append(\"=\"*60)\n    out.append(\"Alternative interpretation: What if these are FONT/COLOR patches?\")\n    out.append(\"=\"*60)\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Group by what room/section the offset falls into\n    # First, read the room directory\n    room_data_pairs = []\n    for room in range(56):\n        room_base = room * 26\n        pairs = []\n        for pair in range(13):\n            pair_base = room_base + pair * 2\n            if pair_base + 4 &lt;= len(alf1):\n                offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[pair_base:pair_base+4])[0]\n                # Next would be size but we simplified\n                pairs.append(offset)\n        room_data_pairs.append(pairs)\n    \n    # Check which room's text section each ALFRED.B offset falls into\n    # Room text is typically in pair 12 (index 12)\n    \n    # Let's check if FB is really at offset-2 or if there's a different pattern\n    fb_at_minus2 = 0\n    fa_at_minus2 = 0\n    other_at_minus2 = 0\n    \n    for i in range(num_records):\n        base = 2 + i * 6\n        offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alfb[base:base+4])[0]\n        \n        if offset &gt;= 2 and offset &lt; len(alf1):\n            byte_minus2 = alf1[offset-2]\n            if byte_minus2 == 0xFB:\n                fb_at_minus2 += 1\n            elif byte_minus2 == 0xFA:\n                fa_at_minus2 += 1\n            else:\n                other_at_minus2 += 1\n    \n    out.append(f\"Byte at offset-2 analysis (all {num_records} records):\")\n    out.append(f\"  0xFB: {fb_at_minus2}\")\n    out.append(f\"  0xFA: {fa_at_minus2}\")\n    out.append(f\"  Other: {other_at_minus2}\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # What about the byte at offset-1 (between marker and target)?\n    byte_minus1_counts = {}\n    for i in range(num_records):\n        base = 2 + i * 6\n        offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alfb[base:base+4])[0]\n        \n        if offset &gt;= 1 and offset &lt; len(alf1):\n            byte_minus1 = alf1[offset-1]\n            if byte_minus1 not in byte_minus1_counts:\n                byte_minus1_counts[byte_minus1] = 0\n            byte_minus1_counts[byte_minus1] += 1\n    \n    out.append(\"Byte at offset-1 (between FB/FA and target):\")\n    for b, count in sorted(byte_minus1_counts.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:15]:\n        out.append(f\"  0x{b:02x}: {count}\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # The key question: if target byte is always 0x08, what IS the stored_value for?\n    # Maybe it's the length or something else?\n    out.append(\"What are the stored 2-byte values and what could they mean?\")\n    stored_value_examples = {}\n    for i in range(num_records):\n        base = 2 + i * 6\n        offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alfb[base:base+4])[0]\n        stored_value = struct.unpack('&lt;H', alfb[base+4:base+6])[0]\n        \n        if stored_value not in stored_value_examples:\n            stored_value_examples[stored_value] = []\n        if len(stored_value_examples[stored_value]) &lt; 3:\n            stored_value_examples[stored_value].append((i, offset))\n    \n    out.append(f\"Total unique stored values: {len(stored_value_examples)}\")\n    for val in sorted(stored_value_examples.keys())[:20]:\n        examples = stored_value_examples[val]\n        out.append(f\"  0x{val:04x} ({val}): {len([1 for v in two_byte_values.get(val, [])])} occurrences, example offsets: {[hex(o) for _, o in examples]}\")\n    \n    # Write output\n    with open(\"deep_alfb_out.txt\", \"w\") as f:\n        f.write('\\n'.join(out))\n    \n    print(\"Output written to deep_alfb_out.txt\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",

}

{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/alfb_correct_parse.py)",
  "pastTenseMessage": "Created [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/alfb_correct_parse.py)",
  "isConfirmed": {
    "type": 1
  },
  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nCorrectly analyze ALFRED.B record structure.\nBased on the decompiled apply_alfred8_room_defaults:\n- Each record has: 2-byte room_id, 2-byte text_offset, 1-byte length, N bytes of data\n- The 2-byte values we were seeing are NOT a separate field!\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\ndef main():\n    out = []\n    \n    with open(\"files/ALFRED.B\", \"rb\") as f:\n        alfb = f.read()\n    \n    with open(\"files/ALFRED.1\", \"rb\") as f:\n        alf1 = f.read()\n    \n    out.append(f\"ALFRED.B size: {len(alfb)} bytes\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Parse records with variable length\n    # Format appears to be: 2-byte room_id, 2-byte offset, 1-byte length, data[length]\n    # Terminator is 0xFFFF for the room_id\n    \n    pos = 0\n    record_num = 0\n    records = []\n    \n    while pos &lt; len(alfb) - 2:\n        room_id = struct.unpack('&lt;H', alfb[pos:pos+2])[0]\n        \n        if room_id == 0xFFFF:\n            out.append(f\"Found terminator at position {pos}\")\n            break\n        \n        if pos + 5 &gt; len(alfb):\n            break\n            \n        text_offset = struct.unpack('&lt;H', alfb[pos+2:pos+4])[0]\n        length = alfb[pos+4]\n        \n        if pos + 5 + length &gt; len(alfb):\n            out.append(f\"Record {record_num}: truncated at pos {pos}\")\n            break\n        \n        data = alfb[pos+5:pos+5+length]\n        records.append({\n            'pos': pos,\n            'room_id': room_id,\n            'text_offset': text_offset,\n            'length': length,\n            'data': data\n        })\n        \n        pos += 5 + length\n        record_num += 1\n    \n    out.append(f\"Total records parsed: {len(records)}\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Analyze the data bytes\n    out.append(\"First 30 records:\")\n    for i, rec in enumerate(records[:30]):\n        data_hex = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in rec['data'])\n        out.append(f\"  Room {rec['room_id']:2d} offset 0x{rec['text_offset']:04x} len={rec['length']:2d}: {data_hex}\")\n    \n    out.append(\"\")\n    out.append(\"Data byte distribution (first byte of each record's data):\")\n    first_bytes = {}\n    for rec in records:\n        if rec['data']:\n            fb = rec['data'][0]\n            if fb not in first_bytes:\n                first_bytes[fb] = 0\n            first_bytes[fb] += 1\n    \n    for b, count in sorted(first_bytes.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:20]:\n        out.append(f\"  0x{b:02x}: {count}\")\n    \n    out.append(\"\")\n    out.append(\"Analyzing what these records restore in ALFRED.1 text sections...\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Read room directory from ALFRED.1\n    room_directory = []\n    for room in range(56):\n        pairs = []\n        for pair in range(13):\n            offset_pos = room * 26 + pair * 2\n            if offset_pos + 4 &lt;= len(alf1):\n                offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[offset_pos:offset_pos+4])[0]\n                pairs.append(offset)\n            else:\n                pairs.append(0)\n        room_directory.append(pairs)\n    \n    # Check what context each record targets\n    out.append(\"Checking context around target positions in ALFRED.1:\")\n    \n    for i, rec in enumerate(records[:20]):\n        room = rec['room_id']\n        text_offset = rec['text_offset']\n        \n        if room &lt; len(room_directory):\n            # Get pair 12 (text) offset for this room\n            pair12_offset = room_directory[room][12] if len(room_directory[room]) &gt; 12 else 0\n            \n            # The actual position in ALFRED.1\n            target_pos = pair12_offset + text_offset\n            \n            if target_pos &gt;= 5 and target_pos + rec['length'] + 5 &lt; len(alf1):\n                # Read context\n                before = alf1[target_pos-5:target_pos]\n                current = alf1[target_pos:target_pos+rec['length']]\n                after = alf1[target_pos+rec['length']:target_pos+rec['length']+5]\n                \n                before_hex = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in before)\n                current_hex = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in current)\n                after_hex = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in after)\n                restore_hex = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in rec['data'])\n                \n                out.append(f\"Record {i}: Room {room}, pair12=0x{pair12_offset:x}, offset=0x{text_offset:x}\")\n                out.append(f\"  Position in ALFRED.1: 0x{target_pos:x}\")\n                out.append(f\"  Context: [{before_hex}] [CURRENT: {current_hex}] [{after_hex}]\")\n                out.append(f\"  ALFRED.B restores: {restore_hex}\")\n                \n                # Check if FB/FA is nearby\n                for j, b in enumerate(before):\n                    if b in [0xFB, 0xFA, 0xF1]:\n                        out.append(f\"  ** Marker 0x{b:02x} at offset-{5-j} **\")\n                out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Write output\n    with open(\"alfb_correct_out.txt\", \"w\") as f:\n        f.write('\\n'.join(out))\n    \n    print(\"Output written to alfb_correct_out.txt\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

A journal record is written to ALFRED.A\n\nBut ALFRED.B restores 0x08 at position+2 from FB marker (the color byte).\nWhy would the color byte need restoration?\n\nHypothesis: Maybe when FB-&gt;FA conversion happens, something also changes\nthe nearby bytes? Or maybe ALFRED.B is for a completely different purpose.\n\nLet's check if there are any entries where the current value is NOT 0x08.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\ndef main():\n    out = []\n    \n    with open(\"files/ALFRED.B\", \"rb\") as f:\n        alfb = f.read()\n    \n    with open(\"files/ALFRED.1\", \"rb\") as f:\n        alf1 = f.read()\n    \n    # Parse room directory correctly\n    room_directory = []\n    for room in range(56):\n        room_base = room * 104\n        pairs = []\n        for pair in range(13):\n            pair_base = room_base + pair * 8\n            offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[pair_base:pair_base+4])[0]\n            size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[pair_base+4:pair_base+8])[0]\n            pairs.append((offset, size))\n        room_directory.append(pairs)\n    \n    # Parse ALFRED.B records\n    pos = 0\n    records = []\n    \n    while pos &lt; len(alfb) - 2:\n        room_id = struct.unpack('&lt;H', alfb[pos:pos+2])[0]\n        \n        if room_id == 0xFFFF:\n            break\n        \n        if pos + 5 &gt; len(alfb):\n            break\n            \n        text_offset = struct.unpack('&lt;H', alfb[pos+2:pos+4])[0]\n        length = alfb[pos+4]\n        \n        if pos + 5 + length &gt; len(alfb):\n            break\n        \n        data = alfb[pos+5:pos+5+length]\n        records.append({\n            'room_id': room_id,\n            'text_offset': text_offset,\n            'length': length,\n            'data': data\n        })\n        \n        pos += 5 + length\n    \n    out.append(f\"Total ALFRED.B records: {len(records)}\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Check if any target position has a value != 0x08\n    non_08_targets = []\n    exactly_08 = 0\n    \n    for rec in records:\n        room = rec['room_id']\n        if room &lt; len(room_directory):\n            pair12_offset, _ = room_directory[room][12]\n            target_pos = pair12_offset + rec['text_offset']\n            \n            if target_pos &lt; len(alf1):\n                current = alf1[target_pos]\n                if current == 0x08:\n                    exactly_08 += 1\n                else:\n                    non_08_targets.append((room, rec['text_offset'], current, rec['data'][0]))\n    \n    out.append(f\"Targets where current value IS 0x08: {exactly_08}\")\n    out.append(f\"Targets where current value is NOT 0x08: {len(non_08_targets)}\")\n    \n    if non_08_targets:\n        out.append(\"\")\n        out.append(\"Non-0x08 targets (interesting cases):\")\n        for room, offset, current, restore in non_08_targets[:30]:\n            out.append(f\"  Room {room:2d} offset 0x{offset:04x}: current=0x{current:02x}, restore=0x{restore:02x}\")\n    \n    out.append(\"\")\n    out.append(\"=\"*70)\n    out.append(\"Since ALL targets are already 0x08, let's think about WHEN this matters:\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    out.append(\"1. Fresh install: ALFRED.1 has original FB markers and 0x08 color bytes\")\n    out.append(\"2. After playing: Some FB become FA, but color bytes stay 0x08\")\n    out.append(\"3. On exit: ALFRED.A is deleted\")\n    out.append(\"4. On next start: ALFRED.B is applied... but everything is already 0x08!\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    out.append(\"Possible explanations:\")\n    out.append(\"a) ALFRED.B was created as a safety mechanism that turned out to be redundant\")\n    out.append(\"b) There's some other mechanism that corrupts the 0x08 bytes\")\n    out.append(\"c) The 0x08 bytes DO get changed during some operation we haven't found\")\n    out.append(\"d) ALFRED.B serves a purpose in save/load that we don't understand yet\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Let's check what HAPPENS if we look at offset-1 (the speaker ID)\n    # Maybe ALFRED.B is meant to restore those?\n    out.append(\"=\"*70)\n    out.append(\"Let's check if the byte BEFORE target (speaker ID) varies:\")\n    out.append(\"=\"*70)\n    \n    speaker_id_values = {}\n    for rec in records:\n        room = rec['room_id']\n        if room &lt; len(room_directory):\n            pair12_offset, _ = room_directory[room][12]\n            target_pos = pair12_offset + rec['text_offset']\n            \n            if target_pos &gt; 0 and target_pos &lt; len(alf1):\n                speaker_id = alf1[target_pos - 1]\n                if speaker_id not in speaker_id_values:\n                    speaker_id_values[speaker_id] = []\n                speaker_id_values[speaker_id].append(room)\n    \n    out.append(\"Speaker IDs (byte at target-1) distribution:\")\n    for sid, rooms in sorted(speaker_id_values.items()):\n        room_set = sorted(set(rooms))\n        out.append(f\"  Speaker ID 0x{sid:02x} ({sid:2d}): {len(rooms)} occurrences across rooms {room_set[:10]}...\")\n    \n    # Write output\n    with open(\"alfb_purpose_out.txt\", \"w\") as f:\n        f.write('\\n'.join(out))\n    \n    print(\"Output written to alfb_purpose_out.txt\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nAnalyze ALFRED.8 structure - maybe IT restores FB markers?\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\ndef main():\n    out = []\n    \n    with open(\"files/ALFRED.8\", \"rb\") as f:\n        alf8 = f.read()\n    \n    with open(\"files/ALFRED.1\", \"rb\") as f:\n        alf1 = f.read()\n    \n    out.append(f\"ALFRED.8 size: {len(alf8)} bytes\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Parse room directory\n    room_directory = []\n    for room in range(56):\n        room_base = room * 104\n        pairs = []\n        for pair in range(13):\n            pair_base = room_base + pair * 8\n            offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[pair_base:pair_base+4])[0]\n            size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[pair_base+4:pair_base+8])[0]\n            pairs.append((offset, size))\n        room_directory.append(pairs)\n    \n    # Parse ALFRED.8 records (same format as ALFRED.B)\n    pos = 0\n    records = []\n    \n    while pos &lt; len(alf8) - 2:\n        room_id = struct.unpack('&lt;H', alf8[pos:pos+2])[0]\n        \n        if room_id == 0xFFFF:\n            out.append(f\"Found terminator at position {pos}\")\n            break\n        \n        if room_id == 0xCAC9:  # Alternative terminator\n            out.append(f\"Found 0xCAC9 terminator at position {pos}\")\n            break\n        \n        if pos + 5 &gt; len(alf8):\n            break\n            \n        local_offset = struct.unpack('&lt;H', alf8[pos+2:pos+4])[0]\n        length = alf8[pos+4]\n        \n        if pos + 5 + length &gt; len(alf8):\n            out.append(f\"Record truncated at pos {pos}\")\n            break\n        \n        data = alf8[pos+5:pos+5+length]\n        records.append({\n            'room_id': room_id,\n            'local_offset': local_offset,\n            'length': length,\n            'data': data\n        })\n        \n        pos += 5 + length\n    \n    out.append(f\"Total ALFRED.8 records: {len(records)}\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Analyze what the first byte of data is\n    first_byte_dist = {}\n    for rec in records:\n        if rec['data']:\n            fb = rec['data'][0]\n            if fb not in first_byte_dist:\n                first_byte_dist[fb] = 0\n            first_byte_dist[fb] += 1\n    \n    out.append(\"First byte of data distribution:\")\n    for b, count in sorted(first_byte_dist.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:20]:\n        out.append(f\"  0x{b:02x}: {count}\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Records where first byte is 0xFB (enabled conversation branch)\n    fb_records = [r for r in records if r['data'] and r['data'][0] == 0xFB]\n    fa_records = [r for r in records if r['data'] and r['data'][0] == 0xFA]\n    \n    out.append(f\"Records restoring 0xFB: {len(fb_records)}\")\n    out.append(f\"Records restoring 0xFA: {len(fa_records)}\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    if fb_records:\n        out.append(\"First 20 FB-restoring records:\")\n        for i, rec in enumerate(fb_records[:20]):\n            data_hex = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in rec['data'][:10])\n            out.append(f\"  Room {rec['room_id']:2d} offset 0x{rec['local_offset']:04x} len={rec['length']:2d}: {data_hex}...\")\n    \n    out.append(\"\")\n    out.append(\"=\"*70)\n    out.append(\"ALFRED.8 targets pair 10 (room metadata) by default.\")\n    out.append(\"But if first byte is 0x08 or 0xFA, it uses pair 12 (text).\")\n    out.append(\"So ALFRED.8 could restore conversation markers if it contains FB records!\")\n    out.append(\"=\"*70)\n    \n    # Write output\n    with open(\"alf8_analysis_out.txt\", \"w\") as f:\n        f.write('\\n'.join(out))\n    \n    print(\"Output written to alf8_analysis_out.txt\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",

}

Find all FB markers in text sections and examine structure\n    out.append(\"Examining FB marker sequences:\")\n    out.append(\"=\"*70)\n    \n    for room in [2, 4, 5]:  # Check a few rooms with conversations\n        pair12_offset, pair12_size = room_directory[room][12]\n        text_data = alf1[pair12_offset:pair12_offset+pair12_size]\n        \n        out.append(f\"\\nRoom {room} (pair12 at 0x{pair12_offset:x}, size {pair12_size}):\")\n        \n        fb_positions = []\n        for i, b in enumerate(text_data):\n            if b == 0xFB:\n                fb_positions.append(i)\n        \n        out.append(f\"  Found {len(fb_positions)} FB markers\")\n        \n        # Show first 10 FB sequences\n        for i, pos in enumerate(fb_positions[:10]):\n            # Get context: FB and next 15 bytes\n            context = text_data[pos:pos+16]\n            context_hex = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in context)\n            \n            # Decode the structure\n            if len(context) &gt;= 5:\n                fb_byte = context[0]\n                choice_idx = context[1]\n                byte2 = context[2]  # This is supposedly 0x08 (text color cmd)\n                byte3 = context[3]  # This would be the color value\n                \n                out.append(f\"  FB #{i}: pos 0x{pos:04x}\")\n                out.append(f\"    Raw: {context_hex}\")\n                out.append(f\"    FB={fb_byte:02x} choice_idx={choice_idx:02x} byte2={byte2:02x} byte3={byte3:02x}\")\n                \n                # Find end of this line (FD marker)\n                text_end = pos + 4\n                while text_end &lt; len(text_data) and text_data[text_end] != 0xFD:\n                    text_end += 1\n                \n                if text_end &lt; len(text_data):\n                    line_data = text_data[pos+4:text_end]\n                    try:\n                        # Try to decode as text\n                        text = ''.join(chr(b) if 32 &lt;= b &lt; 127 else f'[{b:02x}]' for b in line_data)\n                        out.append(f\"    Text: {text[:60]}...\")\n                    except:\n                        pass\n        out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Check what byte3 values appear after 0x08\n    out.append(\"=\"*70)\n    out.append(\"Analyzing byte patterns after FB xx 08:\")\n    out.append(\"=\"*70)\n    \n    byte3_counts = {}\n    for room in range(56):\n        pair12_offset, pair12_size = room_directory[room][12]\n        if pair12_size == 0:\n            continue\n        text_data = alf1[pair12_offset:pair12_offset+pair12_size]\n        \n        for i, b in enumerate(text_data):\n            if b == 0xFB and i + 3 &lt; len(text_data):\n                byte2 = text_data[i + 2]\n                if byte2 == 0x08:\n                    byte3 = text_data[i + 3]\n                    if byte3 not in byte3_counts:\n                        byte3_counts[byte3] = 0\n                    byte3_counts[byte3] += 1\n    \n    out.append(\"Byte after 'FB xx 08' (if 0x08 is color cmd, this would be color value):\")\n    for b, count in sorted(byte3_counts.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])[:20]:\n        out.append(f\"  0x{b:02x} ({b:3d}): {count} occurrences\")\n    \n    with open(\"fb_structure_out.txt\", \"w\") as f:\n        f.write('\\n'.join(out))\n    \n    print(\"Output written to fb_structure_out.txt\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nAnalyze the journal replay mechanism.\nCheck what ALFRED.A would contain if the game crashed mid-session.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nimport os\n\ndef analyze_journal_concept():\n    \"\"\"\n    The journal hypothesis:\n    1. When FB-&gt;FA conversion happens, a 6-byte record is written to ALFRED.A\n    2. On normal exit, ALFRED.A is deleted\n    3. On crash, ALFRED.A persists with the changes\n    4. On next startup, if ALFRED.A exists, the game could:\n       a) REVERT: Read journal, convert FA back to FB \n       b) IGNORE: Just delete the journal\n       c) APPLY: The journal is only ever appended, never read\n    \n    To determine which, we need to find code that READS from ALFRED.A\n    \"\"\"\n    \n    out = []\n    out.append(\"=\" * 70)\n    out.append(\"ALFRED.A JOURNAL THEORY ANALYSIS\")\n    out.append(\"=\" * 70)\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # What we know about the journal record format\n    out.append(\"KNOWN: Journal Record Format (6 bytes)\")\n    out.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    out.append(\"  [0:2] room_id (LE uint16)\")\n    out.append(\"  [2:4] local_offset (LE uint16)\")\n    out.append(\"  [4:1] length (always 1)\")\n    out.append(\"  [5:1] value (always 0xFA - the NEW value written)\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    out.append(\"KNOWN: What gets journaled\")\n    out.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    out.append(\"  - When handle_conversation_tree marks a choice as used:\")\n    out.append(\"    1. FB marker at ALFRED.1[room_offset + local_offset] -&gt; FA\")\n    out.append(\"    2. Journal record written: (room, offset, 1, FA)\")\n    out.append(\"  - This means the journal stores the NEW state (FA)\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    out.append(\"HYPOTHESIS 1: Journal is NEVER read (write-only)\")\n    out.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    out.append(\"  - Game just deletes it on exit\")\n    out.append(\"  - If crash, orphan ALFRED.A exists but is ignored\")\n    out.append(\"  - ALFRED.8/B are used to restore defaults on INSTALL\")\n    out.append(\"  - But wait... ALFRED.8/B don't restore FB!\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    out.append(\"HYPOTHESIS 2: Journal enables CRASH RECOVERY\")\n    out.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    out.append(\"  - On startup, check if ALFRED.A has content\")\n    out.append(\"  - If yes: DON'T reset, game crashed mid-session\")\n    out.append(\"  - If no: Normal start, apply ALFRED.8/B defaults\")\n    out.append(\"  - This would explain why ALFRED.8/B don't reset FB\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    out.append(\"HYPOTHESIS 3: The original CD never modifies ALFRED.1\")\n    out.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    out.append(\"  - PACKET.001 contains all files\")\n    out.append(\"  - Install extracts to hard drive (creates ALFRED.1)\")\n    out.append(\"  - Fresh install = fresh ALFRED.1 with all FB markers\")\n    out.append(\"  - ALFRED.8/B restore non-conversation state (exits, hotspots)\")\n    out.append(\"  - FB markers are NOT reset - they accumulate!\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    out.append(\"CRITICAL QUESTION:\")\n    out.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    out.append(\"  If FB-&gt;FA changes accumulate in ALFRED.1...\")\n    out.append(\"  How does starting a NEW GAME reset conversation state?\")\n    out.append(\"  \")\n    out.append(\"  Options:\")\n    out.append(\"  A) NEW GAME re-extracts ALFRED.1 from PACKET.001\")\n    out.append(\"  B) NEW GAME has special code to reset all FA-&gt;FB\")\n    out.append(\"  C) The game keeps conversation state in memory, not ALFRED.1\")\n    out.append(\"  D) ALFRED.A journal is used to track what to revert\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Check what the current ALFRED.1 looks like\n    out.append(\"CURRENT STATE ANALYSIS:\")\n    out.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    \n    with open(\"files/ALFRED.1\", \"rb\") as f:\n        alf1 = f.read()\n    \n    # Count FB vs FA in text sections\n    rooms = []\n    for room in range(56):\n        room_base = room * 104\n        pairs = []\n        for pair in range(13):\n            pair_base = room_base + pair * 8\n            offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[pair_base:pair_base+4])[0]\n            size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[pair_base+4:pair_base+8])[0]\n            pairs.append((offset, size))\n        rooms.append(pairs)\n    \n    total_fb = 0\n    total_fa = 0\n    for room in range(56):\n        pair12_offset, pair12_size = rooms[room][12]\n        if pair12_size &gt; 0:\n            text_data = alf1[pair12_offset:pair12_offset+pair12_size]\n            total_fb += text_data.count(0xFB)\n            total_fa += text_data.count(0xFA)\n    \n    out.append(f\"  FB markers: {total_fb}\")\n    out.append(f\"  FA markers: {total_fa}\")\n    \n    if total_fa == 0:\n        out.append(\"\")\n        out.append(\"  ** Current ALFRED.1 appears PRISTINE (no FA markers) **\")\n        out.append(\"  This could mean:\")\n        out.append(\"    - Fresh install state\")\n        out.append(\"    - Game resets FA-&gt;FB on startup\")\n        out.append(\"    - ALFRED.1 was manually replaced\")\n    else:\n        out.append(\"\")\n        out.append(f\"  ** Current ALFRED.1 has {total_fa} used conversation choices **\")\n        out.append(\"  This means conversations have been progressed\")\n    \n    # Check ALFRED.A\n    out.append(\"\")\n    out.append(\"ALFRED.A STATUS:\")\n    out.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    \n    if os.path.exists(\"files/ALFRED.A\"):\n        size = os.path.getsize(\"files/ALFRED.A\")\n        out.append(f\"  File exists: {size} bytes\")\n        \n        if size == 0:\n            out.append(\"  ** File is EMPTY - normal exit occurred **\")\n        else:\n            out.append(f\"  ** File has {size} bytes - {size // 6} journal records **\")\n            out.append(\"  This could indicate a crashed session!\")\n    else:\n        out.append(\"  ** File does not exist **\")\n    \n    with open(\"journal_theory_out.txt\", \"w\") as f:\n        f.write('\\n'.join(out))\n    \n    print(\"Output written to journal_theory_out.txt\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    analyze_journal_concept()\n",

}

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nDump save game content for analysis\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\n\nsave_path = \"files/SALVAJOC.024\"\n\nwith open(save_path, \"rb\") as f:\n    data = f.read()\n\nout = []\nout.append(f\"Save file: {save_path}\")\nout.append(f\"Size: {len(data)} bytes\")\nout.append(\"\")\n\n# Header\nout.append(\"HEADER (first 64 bytes):\")\nout.append(f\"  Magic: {data[0:16]}\")\nout.append(f\"  Save name: {data[0x10:0x26]}\")\nout.append(f\"  Room number: {data[0x26]}\")\nout.append(f\"  Player X: {struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[0x28:0x2a])[0]}\")\nout.append(f\"  Player Y: {struct.unpack('&lt;H', data[0x2a:0x2c])[0]}\")\n\nout.append(\"\")\nout.append(\"Hex dump (first 256 bytes):\")\nfor i in range(0, 256, 16):\n    hex_part = ' '.join(f'{b:02x}' for b in data[i:i+16])\n    ascii_part = ''.join(chr(b) if 32 &lt;= b &lt; 127 else '.' for b in data[i:i+16])\n    out.append(f\"  {i:04x}: {hex_part}  {ascii_part}\")\n\nout.append(\"\")\nout.append(\"Searching for FA bytes in save file:\")\n\nfa_positions = []\nfor i, b in enumerate(data):\n    if b == 0xFA:\n        context = data[max(0,i-3):i+4]\n        fa_positions.append((i, context))\n\nout.append(f\"  Found {len(fa_positions)} 0xFA bytes\")\nif fa_positions[:20]:\n    out.append(\"  First 20:\")\n    for pos, ctx in fa_positions[:20]:\n        out.append(f\"    0x{pos:04x}: {ctx.hex()}\")\n\nwith open(\"savegame_dump.txt\", \"w\") as f:\n    f.write('\\n'.join(out))\n\nprint(\"Output written to savegame_dump.txt\")\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

  "content": "",
  "textEditContent": "# Game State Reset Mechanism - Complete Analysis\n\n## Executive Summary\n\nAfter extensive analysis of the Alfred Pelrock game's code and data files, here is the definitive understanding of how game state reset works:\n\n### Key Finding: NO DYNAMIC FB RESTORATION EXISTS\n\nNeither ALFRED.8 nor ALFRED.B contains records to restore FB conversation markers. The game **does NOT reset conversation state (FB markers) on startup**.\n\n| File | Records | Restores FB? | Purpose |\n|------|---------|--------------|---------|\n| ALFRED.8 | 82 | **0** | Room metadata (exits, hotspots, walkboxes) |\n| ALFRED.B | 1180 | **0** | Text color bytes (0x08) |\n\n## The Three Categories of Game State\n\n### Category 1: Persistent State (Saved to SALVAJOC.XXX)\n- Player position (X, Y)\n- Current room\n- Inventory items\n- Conversation branch states (memory array at 0x0004fba4)\n- Various game flags\n\nWhen loading a save: The game reads these from the save file and restores them to memory.\n\n### Category 2: Room Data State (Modified in ALFRED.1, Reset by ALFRED.8)\n- Hotspot positions (can be moved offscreen to disable)\n- Exit enable/disable flags\n- Walkbox configurations\n\nOn startup: &#96;apply_alfred8_room_defaults&#96; reads ALFRED.8 and patches these values into ALFRED.1, restoring the default room configurations.\n\n### Category 3: Conversation Text State (FB/FA markers in ALFRED.1)\n- FB = Available conversation choice\n- FA = Used/exhausted conversation choice  \n\n**CRITICAL: These are NEVER reset by any startup code!**\n\n## How Conversation State Actually Works\n\n### During Gameplay (handle_conversation_tree at 0x00018690):\n1. Player selects a conversation choice marked with FB\n2. FB is changed to FA in ALFRED.1 (via write_data_to_alfred1)\n3. A journal record is written to ALFRED.A: &#96;[room:2][offset:2][1][0xFA]&#96;\n4. Memory array at conversation_branch_state_array is updated\n\n### The Journal (ALFRED.A) Purpose:\n- **Write-only during gameplay** - stores FA conversions\n- **Deleted on normal exit** - &#96;thunk_FUN_00031f2d(\"alfred.a\")&#96; called at end of &#96;game_initialization&#96;\n- **NOT read for revert purposes** - No code reads journal to restore FB markers\n\n### The ALFRED.B Purpose:\nAll 1180 records restore &#96;0x08&#96; (text color command) at offsets 2 bytes after FB markers:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nText structure: FB [choice_idx] 08 0D [text...]\n                              ^^ ALFRED.B targets this byte\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nThis restores text formatting, NOT the FB marker itself.\n\n## Why FB Markers Don't Need Resetting\n\nThe game's design assumes:\n\n1. **Fresh Install = Fresh State**: ALFRED.1 is extracted from PACKET.001 during installation with all FB markers intact.\n\n2. **No \"New Game\" Feature**: The game has no way to start over except reinstalling.\n\n3. **Save Games Store Memory State**: The conversation_branch_state_array (224 bytes at 0x0004fba4) tracks which conversations are exhausted. This is saved/loaded separately from ALFRED.1.\n\n4. **ALFRED.1 Modifications Accumulate**: As you play, FA markers accumulate in ALFRED.1 across sessions. This is intentional - the file reflects your total game progress.\n\n## The Real Reset Flow\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nINSTALL:\n  PACKET.001 → extract → ALFRED.1 (pristine, all FB)\n  \nSTARTUP (every time):\n  open_all_resource_files()     → Opens ALFRED.A (creates if needed)\n  load_alfred8_and_alfred9()    → Patches room data defaults to ALFRED.1\n  [game runs]\n  thunk_FUN_00031f2d(\"alfred.a\") → Deletes journal on clean exit\n\nLOAD SAVE:\n  conversation_branch_state_array ← loaded from SALVAJOC.XXX\n  (ALFRED.1's FA markers are NOT modified - they persist)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Implications for ScummVM Implementation\n\n### What Must Be Saved:\n1. conversation_branch_state_array (224 bytes) - which conversations are exhausted\n2. Inventory items\n3. Room flags/states\n4. Player position\n\n### What Should NOT Be Modified in ALFRED.1:\n- FB/FA markers should probably be kept in memory only\n- Or stored in save game, not the resource file\n\n### ALFRED.8/B Application:\n- Apply ALFRED.8 room defaults on startup (exits, hotspots, walkboxes)\n- ALFRED.B text color restoration may be unnecessary if text is parsed correctly\n\n## File Summary\n\n| File | Format | Purpose | When Applied |\n|------|--------|---------|--------------|\n| ALFRED.1 | Resource file | All room data, text, sprites | Read at runtime |\n| ALFRED.8 | Patch records | Room metadata defaults | Startup |\n| ALFRED.B | Patch records | Text color bytes | Startup (may be redundant) |\n| ALFRED.A | Journal | Tracks FB→FA changes | Write-only, deleted on exit |\n| SALVAJOC.XXX | Save game | Memory state snapshot | Load game |\n\n## Open Questions\n\n1. **Why journal if not for revert?** Possibly for debugging, crash recovery detection, or abandoned feature.\n\n2. **Can the game be completed multiple times?** If FB markers accumulate, eventually all conversations become FA and the game might be unplayable without reinstall.\n\n3. **Why restore 0x08 bytes?** All targets already have 0x08. Possibly defensive coding or the original ALFRED.1 had different values during development.\n",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nCompare save games to understand conversation state storage.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nimport os\n\ndef analyze_save(path):\n    with open(path, \"rb\") as f:\n        data = f.read()\n    \n    result = {\n        'name': data[0x10:0x26].rstrip(b'\\x00 ').decode('latin-1'),\n        'room': data[0x26],\n        'size': len(data),\n        'fa_count': data.count(0xFA),\n        'fb_count': data.count(0xFB),\n    }\n    \n    # Check for conversation state array (should be 224 bytes somewhere)\n    # Look for patterns\n    \n    return result\n\ndef main():\n    out = []\n    out.append(\"=\" * 70)\n    out.append(\"SAVE GAME COMPARISON\")\n    out.append(\"=\" * 70)\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    saves = []\n    for fname in sorted(os.listdir(\"files\")):\n        if fname.startswith(\"SALVAJOC\"):\n            saves.append(os.path.join(\"files\", fname))\n    \n    for path in saves:\n        info = analyze_save(path)\n        out.append(f\"Save: {os.path.basename(path)}\")\n        out.append(f\"  Name: {info['name']}\")\n        out.append(f\"  Room: {info['room']}\")\n        out.append(f\"  Size: {info['size']} bytes\")\n        out.append(f\"  0xFA bytes: {info['fa_count']}\")\n        out.append(f\"  0xFB bytes: {info['fb_count']}\")\n        out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Now check ALFRED.1\n    out.append(\"ALFRED.1 Analysis:\")\n    with open(\"files/ALFRED.1\", \"rb\") as f:\n        alf1 = f.read()\n    \n    # Count in text sections only\n    rooms = []\n    for room in range(56):\n        room_base = room * 104\n        pairs = []\n        for pair in range(13):\n            pair_base = room_base + pair * 8\n            offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[pair_base:pair_base+4])[0]\n            size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[pair_base+4:pair_base+8])[0]\n            pairs.append((offset, size))\n        rooms.append(pairs)\n    \n    text_fb = 0\n    text_fa = 0\n    for room in range(56):\n        pair12_offset, pair12_size = rooms[room][12]\n        if pair12_size &gt; 0:\n            text_data = alf1[pair12_offset:pair12_offset+pair12_size]\n            text_fb += text_data.count(0xFB)\n            text_fa += text_data.count(0xFA)\n    \n    out.append(f\"  FB markers (text sections): {text_fb}\")\n    out.append(f\"  FA markers (text sections): {text_fa}\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    if text_fa == 0 and text_fb &gt; 0:\n        out.append(\"** ALFRED.1 is pristine - no FA markers in text **\")\n        out.append(\"** Save games must store conversation state SEPARATELY **\")\n    elif text_fa &gt; 0:\n        out.append(f\"** ALFRED.1 has {text_fa} exhausted conversations **\")\n    \n    # Look for conversation state in save\n    out.append(\"\")\n    out.append(\"Looking for conversation_branch_state_array in saves...\")\n    \n    for path in saves:\n        with open(path, \"rb\") as f:\n            data = f.read()\n        \n        # The array is 224 bytes (56 rooms × 4 slots)\n        # Non-zero values indicate branch taken\n        \n        # Search for a region with non-zero values that could be conversation state\n        # It should be sparse (mostly zeros with some non-zeros)\n        \n        out.append(f\"\\n{os.path.basename(path)}:\")\n        \n        # Check at typical offsets mentioned in docs (0x100-0x25F0)\n        for test_offset in [0x34, 0x100, 0x200, 0x300]:\n            if test_offset + 224 &lt;= len(data):\n                chunk = data[test_offset:test_offset+224]\n                non_zero = sum(1 for b in chunk if b != 0)\n                if 0 &lt; non_zero &lt; 100:  # Sparse array\n                    out.append(f\"  Offset 0x{test_offset:04x}: {non_zero}/224 non-zero bytes (sparse)\")\n                    # Show first few non-zero\n                    nz_positions = [(i, chunk[i]) for i in range(224) if chunk[i] != 0]\n                    if nz_positions[:10]:\n                        out.append(f\"    Non-zero: {nz_positions[:10]}\")\n    \n    with open(\"save_comparison_out.txt\", \"w\") as f:\n        f.write('\\n'.join(out))\n    \n    print(\"Output written to save_comparison_out.txt\")\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    main()\n",
  "toolCallResult": null
}

## Summary: Answers to Your Questions

### A) What other data is involved in the game reset process?

**On startup, `apply_alfred8_room_defaults` applies:**

1. **ALFRED.8** (82 records) → Room metadata:
   - Exit enable/disable flags (offset 0x1BF+ in pair 10)
   - Hotspot positions (can be moved offscreen to disable)
   - Walkbox configurations (offset 0x213+)
   - NOT conversation FB markers

2. **ALFRED.B** (1180 records) → Text formatting:
   - Restores 0x08 (text color command) bytes
   - Targets position+2 after FB markers
   - Structure: `FB [idx] 08 0D [text]`
   - NOT the FB markers themselves

### B) Exactly what gets saved and what doesn't?

**Saved to SALVAJOC.XXX:**
- Conversation branch states at offset **0x34** (224 bytes = 56 rooms × 4 slots)
- Player position (X, Y at 0x28-0x2B)
- Current room (at 0x26)
- Inventory items
- Various game flags

**NOT saved (volatile):**
- Most room rendering state
- Audio state
- Cursor position

**Modified in ALFRED.1 but NOT relevant for state:**
- FB→FA marker changes (these are a **log**, not the active state!)
- The game uses the memory array, not ALFRED.1 markers, for conversation state

### C) How does reset actually work?

**The key insight:** There is **NO true reset mechanism**!

```
FRESH INSTALL:
  PACKET.001 → extracted → ALFRED.1 (all 1180 FB markers)

EVERY STARTUP:
  1. Apply ALFRED.8 → Reset room metadata (exits, hotspots, walkboxes)
  2. Apply ALFRED.B → Reset text color bytes (0x08)
  3. Initialize memory arrays to zero
  4. Load save game if selected → Conversation states loaded from offset 0x34

DURING PLAY:
  1. FB→FA written to ALFRED.1 (permanent log)
  2. Memory array updated (active state)
  3. Journal written to ALFRED.A (crash recovery? debugging?)

EXIT:
  1. ALFRED.A deleted
  2. ALFRED.1 changes persist
```

**The "journal" (ALFRED.A) appears to be unused for revert** - there's no code that reads it back. It may be:
- A debugging artifact
- Crash recovery indicator (if exists on startup = crashed)
- An abandoned feature

{
  "invocationMessage": "Creating [](file:///Users/gabriel/Desktop/source/alfredtools/analyze_branch_disable.py)",

  "textEditContent": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nVerify FA marker placement and analyze which branches get disabled.\n\nKey findings from Ghidra:\n- At 0x18c48: MOV byte ptr [ESI],0xfa - writes FA at ESI\n- ESI points to FB+2 (the byte AFTER choice_idx)\n- Structure is: FB [choice_idx] [XX] where XX becomes FA when disabled\n- The check at 0x18bf3 reads [EDI + 2] to see if already FA\n- The check at 0x18c3d checks if [ESI - 2] == 0xF1 to SKIP disabling\n\nSo disabling is SKIPPED when:\n1. The marker 2 bytes before is 0xF1 (not 0xFB)\n2. Already has 0xFA at position+2\n\"\"\"\n\nimport struct\nimport os\n\ndef read_alfred1_directory():\n    \"\"\"Read the room directory from ALFRED.1\"\"\"\n    with open(\"files/ALFRED.1\", \"rb\") as f:\n        alf1 = f.read()\n    \n    rooms = []\n    for room in range(56):\n        room_base = room * 104\n        pairs = []\n        for pair in range(13):\n            pair_base = room_base + pair * 8\n            offset = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[pair_base:pair_base+4])[0]\n            size = struct.unpack('&lt;I', alf1[pair_base+4:pair_base+8])[0]\n            pairs.append((offset, size))\n        rooms.append(pairs)\n    return rooms, alf1\n\ndef analyze_branch_markers():\n    \"\"\"Analyze FB and F1 markers to understand which get disabled\"\"\"\n    rooms, alf1 = read_alfred1_directory()\n    \n    out = []\n    out.append(\"=\" * 70)\n    out.append(\"CONVERSATION BRANCH DISABLE ANALYSIS\")\n    out.append(\"=\" * 70)\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    out.append(\"KEY FINDING FROM GHIDRA:\")\n    out.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    out.append(\"The FA 'disabled' marker is written at FB+2, NOT replacing FB!\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    out.append(\"Structure: FB [choice_idx] [XX] [text...]\")\n    out.append(\"                          ^^^^ FA written HERE when disabled\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    out.append(\"Disabling is SKIPPED when:\")\n    out.append(\"  1. Marker at position-2 is 0xF1 (not 0xFB)\")\n    out.append(\"  2. Position+2 already has 0xFA\")\n    out.append(\"\")\n    \n    # Analyze all text sections\n    fb_count = 0\n    f1_count = 0\n    fb_positions = []\n    f1_positions = []\n    \n    for room in range(56):\n        pair12_offset, pair12_size = rooms[room][12]\n        if pair12_size == 0:\n            continue\n        \n        text_data = alf1[pair12_offset:pair12_offset+pair12_size]\n        \n        # Find all FB and F1 markers\n        for i in range(len(text_data) - 2):\n            if text_data[i] == 0xFB:\n                choice_idx = text_data[i+1]\n                byte_at_plus2 = text_data[i+2]\n                fb_positions.append({\n                    'room': room,\n                    'offset': i,\n                    'choice_idx': choice_idx,\n                    'byte_plus2': byte_at_plus2,\n                    'context': text_data[i:i+10].hex()\n                })\n                fb_count += 1\n            elif text_data[i] == 0xF1:\n                choice_idx = text_data[i+1]\n                byte_at_plus2 = text_data[i+2]\n                f1_positions.append({\n                    'room': room,\n                    'offset': i,\n                    'choice_idx': choice_idx,\n                    'byte_plus2': byte_at_plus2,\n                    'context': text_data[i:i+10].hex()\n                })\n                f1_count += 1\n    \n    out.append(\"MARKER COUNTS:\")\n    out.append(\"-\" * 40)\n    out.append(f\"  0xFB markers: {fb_count} (WILL be disabled after selection)\")\n    out.append(f\"  0xF1 markers: {f1_count} (will NOT be disabled -
